name: qlrisk_frtb_sa_capital
title: FRTB Standardised Approach capital
description: FRTB SA capital (MAR21-23): sensitivities-based method, default risk charge and residual risk add-on. Map names to buckets and ratings in `advanced`. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "CorporateBond", "trade_id": "ACME-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 5000000, "coupon_pct": 5, "issuer": "ACME", "counterparty_id": "ACME"}], "advanced": {"credit_buckets": {"ACME": 4}, "ratings": {"ACME": "BBB"}}} gives FRTB SA capital 1,047,144.85 USD: SBM 828,936.07, DRC 218,208.78, RRAO 0.00 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
